title: Calling the Deal
subtitle: Private M&A, from zero
description: From knowing nothing about lawyers or deals to predicting where negotiated terms land from precedent and leverage, and advising whether to pursue. 16 modules, 7 labs on 22 real signed agreements, a 5-hour podcast, handbook and cheatsheet.

title: Clearing the aircraft deal
subtitle: Aircraft sales and leasing
description: Read an aircraft purchase or lease, predict the disputed terms, and price what stays with the buyer or airline. Practise on public SEC exhibits before making the sign, negotiate or walk call.
